title: First halting time
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, and let $c$ be a configuration with a nonhalting state. If the configuration reached after $t$ steps is halted, then there is an integer $u$ with $0<u\le t$ such that every configuration reached at a time $v<u$ is nonhalting, the configuration at time $u$ is halted, and it equals the configuration at time $t$.
hypotheses_covered: A multi-tape machine over the Boolean alphabet
The starting configuration has a nonhalting state
The configuration after t steps is halted
replaced:
Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet and $c$ a configuration
whose control state is live. If $M$ has halted $t$ steps after $c$, then there is a time
$u$ with $0 < u \le t$ such that $M$ is not halted at any time strictly before $u$, is
halted at time $u$, and the configuration at time $u$ equals the configuration at time
$t$.
